caseName: Bayside Fish Flour Co. v. Gentry
caseNameFull: Bayside Fish Flour Co. v. Gentry
attorneys: Mr. Roy Daily for appellant., Messrs. U. S. Webb and Ralph O. Marrón for appellees.

opinions.text: Pursuant to the stipulation of counsel the judgment entered in this case on October 14, 1935, post, p. 660, is vacated and set aside and the case is restored to the docket, to be submitted without oral argument upon briefs to be filed by the appellant on or before December 2 next and by appellees on or before December 16 next. [For later order and opinion, see 297 U. S.]
